Gerry is a [[NPCs|talking skull]] you found buried behind your [[Sweet_Home|home]]. He guides you through your first days as the [[The_Graveyard|graveyard]] keeper. After the graveyard tutorial, he stays in the [[morgue]] and asks for [[quest|alcohol]].

==Quests==

===Get Gerry Beer {{Happiness|+20 }} ===
Gerry asks for beer which requires you to find [[Horadric]] in the [[village]] at [[The Dead Horse|The Dead Horse tavern]].  You can use the{{Item|A mug of beer||Copper}} you earned as a reward for delivering the letter to [[Krezvold]] or purchase one from the tavern (must be {{Quality|Copper}}).

{{Happiness|20 }} enables dialogue with Gerry, telling the player how to get to the [[Alchemy Lab|library]] and about the [[Astrologer]].

===Gunter (Breaking Dead DLC)===
After the [[Days|fourth]] {{Day|Gluttony}} (19.5 days) and reaching {{Happiness|20 }} with Gerry, return to the [[morgue]]. In a cutscene, Gerry will tell you about a [[zombie]] chained in the  [[Sacrifice Zone|northern part of the church cellar]]. 

Visit the [[Gunter]] page for more.

===Get Gerry Wine {{Happiness|+20 }} ===
Gerry still isn't drunk and decides to make it your problem. He wants {{item|red wine||Silver}}. You can make it yourself or purchase some from [[Horadric]] (must be {{Quality|Silver}}). Gerry tells you that the [[Astrologer]] had the best wine, but he doesn't sell it.

==Stranger Sins DLC==

The Stranger Sins DLC adds a backstory to Gerry and expands on other characters. It explains the Ancient Contract, the Ancient Curse, and what made the world today.

===Get Gerry Cognac===

[[File:Gerry Dig up Cognac.png|thumb|500px|The mound containing the cognac]]

[[red wine|Wine]] isn't strong enough for Gerry, who asks you to find him cognac instead. Whenever you speak to him again he will have remembered where he and an old keeper buried some cognac. Several interactable mounds spawn between [[The Village]] and the [[Lighthouse]]. These look like grass with rocks around them and only spawn after this dialogue. 

After digging up the one north of [[Dig]], a cutscene will play where Gerry tells you about what you've found. [[Krezvold]] interrupts to tell you that you can't dig in the Village unless you're a landowner. 

===The Talking Skull===

Return to the [[morgue]] and speak with Gerry. He will tell you his plan to buy land to open a tavern as a front for digging out the cellar and using the machine. You must speak with [[Horadric]] in the [[The Dead Horse|tavern]] and ask to purchase land. Speak to [[Dig]] and then return to Horadric and ask to purchase land in Dig's name; this will cost {{Money|3000}}. Horadric will tell you that [[Cory]] and [[Tress]] can help you, but you can only speak to Corey about building the tavern. 

You have two options: Pay them {{Money|20000}} to finish the barn and build the tavern. Or give them: {{item|simple iron parts|12 }}, {{item|Wooden plank|12 }}, and {{item|nails|12 }} for the barn, and pay {{Money|5000}} to build [[Talking Skull|The Talking Skull]]. 
If you pay them {{Money|20000}}, despite saying the tavern will be ready by dawn, it will when you next sleep. If you provided materials, they will finish the barn the next day and ask for {{Money|5000}}. The next time you sleep, they will have finished the tavern.

Gerry's task will tell you to speak to him once the tavern is finished. He will be in the morgue, although you don't need to speak to him. He will be in the talking skull the first time you enter. You can also teleport there with the [[teleportstone]] as soon as you wake.

When you first enter the Talking Skull, Gerry will politely ask you to make a [[Barman Doll]]. Do this at any tier [[carpenter's workbench]]. Once you have made the barman and placed it behind the bar, there will be a cutscene. Gerry will tell you to meet him in the [[Talking Skull Cellar]] after speaking with the barman; Gerry will not speak to you until you do.

Visit the [[Talking Skull]] page for more details on that aspect of Stranger Sins.

=== Blast from the Past ===

Once you speak to Gerry and break the wall, he will send you on 17 fetch quests, each with its own cutscene. Most villagers have items, but some are buried. Gerry hopes the machine will help him remember who he is.

== Better Save Soul DLC ==

===Get the old rusty key===
After meeting [[Euric]], he will ask you about the [[old rusty key]] and mentions about Gerry, you go to Gerry and talk to him about a bath, this being just a plan to get the key without mentioning it to Gerry. This questline requires {{Item|A mug of beer|1|1}} and {{Item|River sand|1}} to obtain the [[old rusty key]] item to continue the quest. (''Note: No other quality beer is acceptable.'')

After repairing the bed in Euric's room, you get a old teeth (need to check the in game name), giving it to Gerry will reward you with some dialogues.{{Navbox-NPCs}}
